title: Rings
_comment: Mutable Instruments Rings (engines/rings/): the resonator. STRUCTURE, BRIGHTNESS, DAMPING and POSITION are the module's four knobs; what STRUCTURE does depends on the model (web/app/devices/rings.js names it).

params.name: Model
params.help: What rings: bars and bells, strings with sympathetic ones, a plucked string, FM, chords.

params.name: Polyphony
params.help: How many notes ring at once; fewer voices are richer (more partials each).

params.name: Structure
params.help: The material or the chord: wood to glass to bells, or the sympathetic strings' tuning.

params.name: Brightness
params.help: How bright the strike and the ringing are: felt to metal. Harder notes are brighter.

params.name: Damping
params.help: How long notes ring: low is a short thud, high rings for seconds.

params.name: Position
params.help: Where it is struck: the middle is hollow, the ends are bright and thin.

params.name: Transpose
params.help: Moves the notes up or down in semitones; the sympathetic strings' drone (C) moves too.

params.name: Preset
params.help: The preset the part started from (the device marks it * once you change it).

params.name: Input
params.help: What strikes it: its own exciter, or a channel's sound, ringing at the notes' pitch.

_presets: Volumes balanced to -21 dBFS, as Plaits' (RINGS_LOUDNESS=1 tests/host/build/rings_test; +6 dB at most). Two per genre, starting points for the genre packs to tune by ear (genre 0 trance, 1 electro, 2 synthwave, 3 dub techno). params: RN_P_MODEL .. RN_P_TRANSPOSE. Names fit the device (10 characters).
